response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that staff cannot confidently adjust reserves due to unclear role permissions, especially before payment triggers. I checked the five similar items: shortcut 4130 (completed payment history view), the Notion 'Reserve history audit export' page (export of audit trail of adjustments), 4134 (task list improvements, uncompleted), 4132 (completed activity timeline), and 4135 (claim information display, uncompleted). None of these address role-based permission clarity for reserve adjustments; the closest item, the audit export, covers recording what happened rather than defining who is authorized to adjust reserves. No shipped story or roadmap item solves this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
